verdict.rationale: Numeral documents a full certificate lifecycle: triggering `certificate_request` to collect from customers, automatic validation of uploaded certificates, listing/retrieving certificates with per-jurisdiction validity, and expiration tracking/renewals/compliance monitoring, plus a pricing-page feature explicitly called 'Exemption certificate management'. However, the evidence never explicitly states that stored certificates are automatically applied to exempt a transaction at tax-calculation time (the calculation endpoint docs focus on address/product/IP inputs, not certificate lookups). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that calculation calls automatically reference stored valid certificates to zero-out/exempt tax, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this automation.
